# Typed constructor integer default

An owned generic constructor forwards an exact class-scoped class token and two scalar inputs to another constructor, adding an independently defined integer zero. The complete original signatures supply every generic relationship; the literal supplies only its integer value.

The immutable observer exercises both constructors through four independent call routes over repeated attempts. It checks nonzero direct target inputs as well as the zero default, exact class-token and instance identities, initialization order, partial construction, suffix effects, null and unrelated class tokens, and exact failure identity. Source and package-access profiles preserve the complete compiler definition inventory and metadata. Independently compiled wrong programs must fail the observer.
